issues.issue: Whether CARL's intervention would add to or alter the issues or merely duplicate the respondent's arguments (motion for leave to intervene)
issues.applicant_position: CARL: its submissions on broader IRPA implications will assist the Court and will not add to or alter the issues.
issues.respondent_position: Minister opposes: intervention would add to or alter issues and duplicate respondent's submissions. Gaytan does not oppose.
issues.result_quote: CARL can offer the Court a different perspective on the implications of various provisions of the IRPA to the issues in this appeal

issues.issue: Whether the interests of justice favour CARL's intervention
issues.applicant_position: CARL: it has genuine interest, knowledge and resources and will dedicate them to the appeal.
issues.respondent_position: Minister opposes the motion; Gaytan does not oppose.
issues.result_quote: CARL has demonstrated that it has a genuine interest in this matter

issues.issue: Whether CARL may make oral submissions at the appeal hearing
issues.applicant_position: CARL seeks the right to make oral submissions at the hearing of the appeal.
issues.result_quote: I will defer this request for consideration by the panel hearing the appeal
